notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR detail page and the Talladega National Forest Wikipedia article were read. An Anniston Star article ('Grant allows restoration of fire tower', annistonstar.com) appeared in a search snippet describing a Friends of the Talladega National Forest effort to restore a Bankhead tower north of Heflin. Both fetch_text and WebFetch returned HTTP 429, so it is neither read nor cited. Retry it: it is the likeliest source for current condition and access. The maker claim is the register writer's hedged belief and is kept hedged. Brief elevation (419.1 m) and USFS agency match the register; no corrections. The name 'Bankhead' points to a different national forest, so the register's Talladega placement should be double-checked against the Forest Service. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the story's no-condition-change line was narrowed to 'in the sources we could read', because the unread Anniston Star snippet may describe restoration work on a tower north of Heflin (Cleburne County).
